gloss: curriculum vitae; resume; career history document

definitions.gloss: curriculum vitae; resume; career history document
definitions.explanation: A formal document detailing one's career and educational history, used in job applications.

notes:
A document summarizing one's professional career and qualifications. In Japanese job applications, ⟦{職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ}→職務経歴書：08724_shokumukeirekisho⟧ (detailed work history) is typically submitted alongside the ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧ (standardized personal data form). While ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧ follows a fixed format, {経歴書|けいれきしょ} is more flexible and focuses on work experience and achievements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{職務|しょくむ}→職務：13908_shokumu⟧{経歴書|けいれきしょ}: detailed work history (the full formal name)
- {経歴書|けいれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to prepare a resume
- {経歴書|けいれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a resume

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧: personal history form — standardized form with photo, basic info, education, and work history
- ⟦{職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ}→職務経歴書：08724_shokumukeirekisho⟧: detailed work experience document — the full formal term emphasizing job duties
